title: PIMoE: Towards Efficient MoE Transformer Deployment on NPU-PIM System through Throttle-Aware Task Offloading
problem: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) Transformer inference suffers from data transfer overhead and imbalanced workload distribution between NPU and processing-in-memory (PIM) components.
motivation: MoE scaling promises larger models but requires efficient deployment on heterogeneous hardware to address the mismatch between sparse expert selection and memory-compute co-location.
method: PIMoE combines NPU and PIM in a heterogeneous system with throttle-aware task offloading to balance workload based on processing capability, and designs a near-memory-controller data condenser to handle sparse data layout translation between NPU and PIM domains.
key_novelty: Throttle-aware dynamic task offloading that adapts workload distribution based on real-time throttling feedback from heterogeneous compute units.
contributions: Heterogeneous NPU-PIM architecture for MoE Transformer inference
Throttle-aware task offloading method to address workload imbalance
Near-memory-controller data condenser for efficient sparse data layout translation
4.5x speedup and 13.7x energy efficiency over A100
primary_theme: heterogeneous MoE inference via adaptive task offloading
